limitations: Uniform nonzero hopping magnitude and common Peierls phase on a ring of n>=3 sites
Two indistinguishable noninteracting bosons; strictly positive pair-loss rates at every collision site
Only asymptotic eventual collision capture is classified; no finite-time rates, extra potentials, interacting particles, missing detectors or nonuniform hoppings are covered
Historical priority may be affected by earlier unindexed two-body magnetic-dissipation work
scientific_integrity: The all-size statement is proved by exact Fourier-sector analysis. Finite matrix computations corroborate but cannot certify it in untested dimensions. title: Flux-selective collision immunity of two bosons on a magnetic ring
